title: Confidential Information
definition: A secrecy violation occurs when confidential or restricted company information is disclosed, shared, or handled without proper authorization.
violations: Sharing restricted information with an unauthorized person
Improper handling of confidential company information
exceptions: Preventing disclosure before an agreement is formally executed
Disclosure restrictions required by an authorized agreement
examples: Sending confidential documents to an unauthorized recipient
Sharing restricted company information with an external party without authorization

title: Market Bribery
definition: Market bribery involves offering, promising, giving, requesting, or receiving an improper payment, gift, benefit, or advantage to influence a business or market-related decision.
violations: Offering an improper payment to influence a decision
Offering an improper benefit to a business partner
examples: Offering money to influence a business decision
Offering an inappropriate gift in exchange for favorable treatment

title: Market Manipulation
definition: Market manipulation involves intentionally attempting to artificially influence the price, supply, demand, or trading activity of a financial instrument.
violations: Creating false or misleading market activity
Spreading misleading information to influence trading
examples: Coordinating transactions to artificially influence a security price
Creating misleading information to influence market activity

title: Employee Ethics
definition: Employee ethics violations involve dishonest, inappropriate, unethical, or improper conduct that conflicts with company standards.
violations: Conflicts of interest that violate company requirements
examples: Using a position for an improper personal benefit

title: Complaints
definition: Complaints involve reports or concerns regarding inappropriate employee conduct, business practices, or company processes.
violations: Improper handling of a formal complaint
Ignoring a complaint that requires appropriate handling
examples: An employee reporting inappropriate workplace conduct
A customer raising a formal complaint about a business practice

title: Unauthorized Communication Channels
definition: Change in communication involves moving business communication from approved company channels to unauthorized personal or external communication channels.
violations: Moving business discussions to unauthorized messaging applications
Using personal communication channels for restricted business information
Moving business communication outside approved company systems
examples: Moving a business discussion to a personal messaging application
Asking an employee to continue company business through a personal email account
